Evry Customer Specialist

turns.q: Is a damaged item handled differently from a normal return?
turns.replyTail:
Yes, it’s handled differently. A normal change-of-mind return or exchange isn’t accepted because all sales are final. A damaged item can be reviewed under the Standard Warranty if the damage is reported within 30 days of delivery.

Please submit your order number, a clear photo or video, and a description of the damage. If approved, the same item can be replaced when available. If it’s unavailable, store credit for the amount paid is issued. Refunds aren’t offered for warranty claims 💖

turns.q: How long does the replacement take?
turns.replyTail: Once your claim is approved and the replacement ships, Priority Shipping typically takes 2 to 7 business days for domestic deliveries, or 15 to 20 business days for international deliveries. These timeframes start from the shipment date and don’t include processing time. Weather, holidays, or customs clearance can add delays 💖

turns.q: What if more than one item in my order is affected?
turns.replyTail:
If more than one item is damaged, include all affected items in the same claim and upload a clear photo or video of each one, along with your order number and a description of each issue.

The claim is handled as one outcome for the affected items, not a mix of some replacements and some store credit. If a replacement is approved, all affected items must be in stock. If any affected item is out of stock, store credit is issued instead. Submit the claim here: https://evryjewels-claims.web.app/ 💖

turns.q: Will the replacement ship with priority?
turns.replyTail:
If your claim is approved for a replacement, it will be sent using our standard shipping service. Priority Shipping is the standard option for most regions, but Express Delivery isn’t automatically included.

Once shipped, delivery typically takes 2 to 7 business days domestically or 15 to 20 business days internationally. These estimates start from the shipment date and don’t include processing time 💖

turns.q: What if the replacement is also damaged?
turns.replyTail:
If a replacement arrives damaged, please submit a new claim with a clear photo of the replacement, its order number, and a description of the damage here: https://evryjewels-claims.web.app/ 💖

Because a replacement has already been issued, the new claim needs an additional review before any further remedy is decided. A second replacement isn’t automatic.
